name: Lost&Found
detailed_description:
Olivia Sasaki's life has been anything but easy. Growing up in a challenging home environment has made her hesitant to reach out to new people, so she has mostly kept to herself throughout her life. However, all that's changing now. This 16-year-old is moving from America to Japan to live with her brother Jacob and get a fresh start. Although she has visited Japan many times to see her grandfather, it's still a different place with new challenges she must overcome.

The game starts during her first day of school. Olivia tries to go unnoticed and keep herself out of other people's business. Unfortunately, things take a turn for the worst during lunch when she trips, making a mess on both the cafeteria floor and all over herself. The laughter of her classmates echoes off the walls, and camera flashes capture the embarrassing moment—everyone seems to revel in her misfortune.

Everyone, that is, except for one compassionate girl, Chiharu. With her bright smile and warm demeanor, Chiharu rushes to Olivia's side, helping her to her feet and offering comfort amidst the laughter. The two share a bond as they navigate the end of the school day together, with Chiharu inviting Olivia to meet her circle of friends.

In this group, there are six individuals (not counting Olivia). Chiharu is the ever-supportive friend with an infectious energy that draws people in.

Next is Yukina, famed for her striking pink hair and effortless coolness; her sassy jokes make her the life of the party.

Then there's Niko, her twin brother, a master of humor who thrives on making others laugh but often finds himself in friendly competition with Yukina as she tries to one-up his jokes.

Junichiro stands out as a charming heartthrob with an effortlessly magnetic personality and has a lot of curiosity about other places in the world, especially America.

Girls often flock around him, but his heart belongs to the intelligent, graceful Keisuke, who exudes a calm confidence and easily navigates conversations.

Lastly, there’s Minoru, whose tough exterior may lead one to think he's aloof or unkind, yet beneath that façade lies a genuinely caring person willing to lend a hand to those in need.

As Olivia immerses herself in this dynamic group, the story unfolds, revealing deeper layers of each character while also guiding her on a journey of self-discovery. So, are you prepared for the adventures that await? Take your time to learn about these intriguing individuals, and in the process, you just might uncover hidden facets of yourself along the way.

During this story we get to talk to everyone and pick different options with each character and find some lost objects along the way!

Project Petunia
